verses.1: In his twenties, David changed his ways before Abimelech. Then he drove him away and went his own way.
verses.2: Bless God at all times, always with praise in my mouth.
verses.3: In the LORD, my soul shall be healed; it will hear the cries of those who are in need and rejoice.
verses.4: Let us grow in the Lord, and let His name be praised together.
verses.5: I have sought refuge in Jehovah; He saved me from all my troubles and from every danger.
verses.6: Look at him, and flee from him; turn away from him.
verses.7: He cried out in need, and Jehovah heard him. From all his troubles, he was saved.
verses.8: HONE, the servant of Jehovah, surrounded his followers and saved them.
verses.9: They tasted and saw that it was good from the Lord, for He showed them His kindness.
verses.10: Let them see that Jehovah is holy; for there is no one who can protect those who fear Him.
verses.11: May they be filled with wisdom and have no hunger; may the servants of the LORD have nothing lacking in all that is good.
verses.12: Let the children listen to me; let them fear the LORD.
verses.13: Who is this man who desires life, who loves to see good things?
verses.14: May your words be different from evil, and may your speech be free from lies.
verses.15: Avoid evil and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.16: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and His ears are attentive to their prayers.
verses.17: The face of the LORD will be against those who do evil, so that they may be destroyed from the earth.
verses.18: They cried out, and Jehovah heard them. From all their troubles, He saved them.
verses.19: YHWH is close to those whose hearts are pure, and He saves those whose spirits are true.
verses.20: May the many evils of the wicked be removed from us, and may Jehovah save us from them all.
verses.21: He keeps all his possessions together; none of them is left behind.
verses.22: The wicked will be punished, and the righteous will be blessed.
verses.23: May the Lord have mercy on His servants, and may they not be punished for all their sins.
